snapshot_purpose: Unmodified spreadsheet card text for V5 parity audits, not a claim that engine effects are synchronized

cards.name: Oshi
cards.effect: Tachiai: Reveal the top card of your deck and add its Tachiai orbs. If the revealed card is Oshi, Bad Oshi, or Tsuki, continue revealing and adding orbs until you reveal a card that is none of those. Exchange: Gain 1 Play. Draw 1 card. If your Momentum is 0 or higher, gain 1 Push. Exchange: After resolving the other effects, Mill 1 (move the top card of your Draw Pile to your Discard Pile).
cards.classification: Fixed Playtest · This chat: revised
